Name: BlastCap
Author: YourPeachiness
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[code]Four explosive crops plus a damage-halving Tin Bucket Hat. Right-click to place, right-click to ignite.

[The four plants]
- Blast Cap (5 coffee beans): a 13x13 blast that destroys rocks, ore and monsters in range. 20 HP if it catches you.
- Frost Cap (3 beans): freezes monsters in a 13x13 area for 4 seconds.
- Fire Pepper (no beans): detonates on placement and burns outward in a growing circle, taking rock, objects and monsters with it.
- Thunder Cap (4 beans): weaves a 19x19 net of lightning that strikes monsters and cracks open rock and ore.

[How to play]
Right-click to place, right-click to ignite (costs beans). Changed your mind? Left-click to pick an unlit mushroom back up.
No location restrictions - the mines, your farm and the greenhouse all work, and blasts destroy exactly what a vanilla bomb would.
Unlit plants stay where you left them, across area changes and saves.

[Tin Bucket Hat]
Halves every damage source above and survives 6 explosions; on the 6th it gets knocked off and is gone.
Buy another from Pierre for 50g (unlimited stock).

[Coffee Beans]
Beans are your ammo. The day after you install the mod, Pierre mails you a letter with 50 beans enclosed.
When you run out, fight Dust Sprites in the mines (they drop beans) or grow a Coffee Bean plant -
mature plants give you a few beans every 2 days, which lasts a long while. Fire Peppers need none at all.

[Easter eggs]
All four are purely visual, they don't affect balance and they don't hand you any items - read on if you want the list:
- Lightning Rod: wear the Tin Bucket Hat and let your own lightning strike you, and the hat gets knocked clean off.
  (It leaves one line behind: "Tin Bucket Hat: ...so much for being insulated.")
- Moonlight Frost: light a Frost Cap after 8pm and the cold glow turns to moonlight - the snow drifts slower,
  floats gently upward, and the whole area twinkles with little stars.
- Moonlight Butterflies: light a Frost Cap at night and two or three white butterflies rise out of the frost and flit around you.
- Heart Flame: detonate a Fire Pepper anywhere outside the mines (your farm, the greenhouse, anywhere outdoors)
  and the fire spreads into an orange-red heart. Inside the mines it stays a plain circle - down there you're working, not wooing.[/code][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[code]Requires SMAPI 4.0+ and Stardew Valley 1.6+[/code]

Manifest.Name: 爆破菇 (Blast Cap)
Manifest.Description: 种下四种会爆炸的植物，带到哪儿都能用——矿洞、农场、温室都行（爆炸和原版炸弹一样，会毁掉范围内的作物、物件与石头）。右键放下、右键点燃，点燃即爆：爆破菇（5 咖啡豆，13×13 大爆炸，自伤 20）、霜冻菇（3 咖啡豆，冻住 13×13 内怪物 4 秒）、火辣椒（0 咖啡豆，放下即爆，从原地烧出一圈越来越大的火，每 0.5 秒烧 8 点）、闪电菇（4 咖啡豆，在附近 19×19 织出一张雷网，劈怪也劈开石头与矿石，劈中玩家 15 点）。爆炸会把范围内的泥土地翻成耕地；未点燃的植物在换场景或存档时自动退回背包。铁桶帽在皮埃尔商店有卖：戴着它上面这些伤害通通减半，能顶 6 次爆炸、第 6 次被掀飞，飞了就再去买一顶。所有数值都能在 config.json 里自己调。 / Grow four explosive plants and use them anywhere - the mines, your farm, or the greenhouse (blasts destroy crops, objects and rocks in range, just like vanilla bombs). Right-click to place, right-click to ignite: Blast Cap (5 coffee beans, 13x13 blast, 20 self-damage), Frost Cap (3 beans, freezes monsters for 4s), Fire Pepper (no beans, burns outward in a growing circle, 8 HP per 0.5s), Thunder Cap (4 beans, a 19x19 lightning net that strikes monsters and cracks open rock and ore, 15 HP if it hits you). Blasts also till the soil in range, and unlit plants return to your bag when you leave the area or save. The Tin Bucket Hat is sold by Pierre: it halves every damage source above, survives 6 explosions, then gets knocked off - buy another one when it's gone. Every number is configurable in config.json.
Manifest.Author: HoneyPeach
